name: taller-petstore
description: Pruebas de API del taller con Newman (requiere: npm install -g newman newman-reporter-htmlextra)

scripts.test:datos: newman run "Taller Petstore.postman_collection.json" -e "Petstore - QA.postman_environment.json" --folder "Datos desde archivo" -d datos/mascotas.csv
scripts.test:reporte: newman run "Taller Petstore.postman_collection.json" -e "Petstore - QA.postman_environment.json" --folder "CRUD Mascota" -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/reporte.html --reporter-junit-export reports/junit.xml
scripts.test:allure: newman run "Taller Petstore.postman_collection.json" -e "Petstore - QA.postman_environment.json" --folder "CRUD Mascota" --folder "Datos desde archivo" -d datos/mascotas.csv -r cli,allure --reporter-allure-export allure-results
scripts.allure:reporte: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
